title: VPC Watchtower: Terraform upgrade-and-health harness for subnet/egress stacks
creator: Ravi Patel
description: Build a reusable Terraform module and orchestration harness ("VPC Watchtower") that performs safe, observable upgrades and runtime health validation for VPC networking stacks used in Private deployments. Scope: subnet templates, route table reconciliation, NAT/IGW lifecycle, interface VPC endpoints, and egress routing policies. Deliverables include a parameterized module, canary upgrade workflow hooks, synthetic probe jobs for subnets and endpoints, a reconciliation controller (Terraform + small operator script), and runbook updates.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes inputs for subnet profiles (public, app/private, db) and auto-assigns route table+NAT/IGW bindings
Upgrade hook supports canary apply to a selected AZ (1/3 of subnets) and automatic rollback on probe failures
Synthetic probes (ICMP/tcp:443/HTTPS health checks) validate endpoint reachability and egress behavior post-upgrade
Route table drift detection alerts to console with reconcilation PR recommendation
Module has terragrunt-friendly interfaces and example overlays for AWS and hybrid on-prem gateway mapping
